notes.title: Playtest Sign-up Now Open!
notes.content: [p]Hey Everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We are very excited to announce the grand opening of Your World public playtesting![/p][p][/p][p]We hope you will join us as we playtest multiplayer parks filled with fun activities. You can ride coasters and amusement park rides with other players, compete in mini-games for top leaderboard status, experience live concerts, or just hang out and socialize with other members of the community.[/p][p][/p][p]If you would like to join us, please click the Playtest button on the Your World store page.[/p][p][/p][p]If you would like an immediate Playtest key, you can also use our signup form here:   [url="https://mailchi.mp/5ce47f54506b/your-world-sign-up"]https://mailchi.mp/5ce47f54506b/your-world-sign-up[/url] [/p][p]Or, get your key through our Discord here: [url="https://discord.gg/9YSnA3Raq6"]https://discord.gg/9YSnA3Raq6[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Your world is a social game that is best experienced with other players.    Currently, there are 350 players on standby.   Our goal is to open the parks once the player count reaches 500.  We are looking forward to stress testing our server with more players than ever![/p][p][/p][p]Initially, we will release the runtime player, which allows you to experience our completed parks in full.  These parks include:[/p][p][/p][h2]Adventure World  [/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394123/5c81aa96f6363f7ecac03720cfa9a1aaff5d6b1b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394123/3bdfbc6403df8d85cadee469d8064d55dd37a8f4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394123/e84c8e7c47a4c50face65da53aa9570ba935be3d.jpg"][/img][/p][h3] A highly detailed, massive park featuring:[/h3][list][*][p]Rideable Wing coaster[/p][/*][*][p]Rideable Drop Tower, Turbo, Polyp, and Backflash amusement park rides[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer go-kart racing[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer hang-gliding competition[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer skydiving competition[/p][/*][*][p]Underground dungeon side scroller game[/p][/*][*][p]Live concert stage with a streamed concert[/p][/*][*][p]Apparel and vehicle rental shops to spend the coins you earn playing games[/p][/*][*][p]Music and video streamed throughout the park[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Tropical World[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394123/474522001771ab52936bebc22ea37245f0c7722c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394123/ad47a792652e1bdbba6cd8d9c5384ad74cd1b795.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394123/baa474aaf6178e9f14ec7ad40840212a5b26e8b0.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]A beautiful tropical getaway featuring:[/h3][list][*][p]Multiplayer jet ski racing[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer paintball[/p][/*][*][p]Wood coaster[/p][/*][*][p]Live water fountain show[/p][/*][*][p]Rideable Drop Tower and Carousel[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer go-kart racing[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer hang-gliding competition[/p][/*][/list][p]Each game has its own leaderboard displayed near the front of the gate.  Players with the fastest time or highest score will reach the top of each leaderboard. There is also a massive leaderboard tower at the park entrance displaying the top-ranking players for the entire park.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394123/50abd5e090022c7b8519b02a2bb7942ce007897c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Tomorrowland Circa 1979[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394123/0bb852cdc0fd03cb37fdbd61e481af165450694d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394123/f68ad8e75223e6cf8db77a2d2eb44f6e9a048bff.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394123/64a5e070daad16c7c6991406a93c19862972ffa3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394123/73df650522ce49c98f4ad2c4c178eb3174c9841f.png"][/img][/p][h3]We are also very proud to present Tomorrowland Circa 1979, created by Dr. Todd West.  [/h3][p]Built in Unreal and the Your World Editor, Todd has meticulously created an amazing recreation of Tomorrowland as it existed in 1979, featuring:[/p][list][*][p]Authentic Mission to Mars experience[/p][/*][*][p]Rideable Star Jets[/p][/*][*][p]Rideable People Mover[/p][/*][*][p]Grand Prix (upcoming)[/p][/*][*][p]Live firework show above Space Mountain[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We are super excited to be opening our multiplayer parks and hope you will join our growing playtest community![/p][p][/p][p]If you have any questions or would like an immediate playtest key, feel free to reach out on our Discord:  [url="https://discord.gg/9YSnA3Raq6"]https://discord.gg/9YSnA3Raq6[/url][/p][p][/p][p]See you in the park![/p]
